display_long_description:
Your truck. Your road. Your American dream, in VR.

Climb into the cab and live the full trucker life on Meta Quest 3 and 3S. Take delivery jobs across a world inspired by Arizona: long desert highways, cities and scenic routes, changing weather and unexpected situations on the road.
[media]
• Drive 6 American and European trucks, each with its own handling
• Plug in the trailer lines, refuel, wash, service and repair your truck with your own hands
• Grow from a single truck into a trucking company: HQ, new trucks, licenses and bigger jobs
• Explore 12 regions across 3 biomes, with 25+ hours of progression and relaxed road trips
• Make it yours with 350+ customization items, an interactive cab and radio for the long hauls
[media]
EARLY ACCESS
The game is fully playable today, and we keep building it together with players. Updates arrive regularly. Coming next:
• Now: forklift and bulldozer cargo, sound upgrades
• November: story update, new cargo, traffic and visual upgrades, air horn, ambient sounds
• December: global leaderboard, winter events, daily and weekly events, trophies, Tucson
• 2027: maneuvering challenges, glove skins, hiring drivers, night driving, changing wheels

The full roadmap is in Updates. Plans can change, and your feedback decides a lot of what comes first. Report bugs and share ideas on our Discord: discord.gg/YK3yccnxM4
